messages:
alina: Heads up: prepping RC private-installer:v1.6.1 for private VPC delivery. Doing a full dry-run with deploy-bot now. Need escort manifest chunking validated for slow carriage.
ryan: Sending chunk plan now. We'll use 10MB chunks with seq checks and resume tokens for interrupted transfers. Vendor asked for chunk index in manifest.
packaging-bot: Artifact bundle present: private-installer:v1.6.1@sha256:aa11...cc33; signatures: cosign:v0.20; shrinkwrap: disabled per compat.
alina: Good. Please set artifact policy to "strict-pin" in release.json and include the resume-token field.
deploy-bot: Running dry-run: steps -> preflight, manifest-verify, chunked-upload-sim, canary-sim. Logs: https://logs.redwood/dryrun/3419900123
ops-oncall: Note: mirror egress throttles at vendor side. We'll schedule a slower rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC to avoid bursts.
vendor-ops: Confirmed. Our courier will accept chunked uploads at 02:05 UTC. Need escort-manifest by 01:45 UTC.
security: Reminder: rotate the temporary signer and publish public key fingerprint in the manifest. Also add `cosign-checksum` field.
ryan: Added signer fingerprint and cosign-checksum. Sending updated manifest to S3: https://s3.redwood/internal/rcs/1.6.1/escort-manifest.json
packaging-bot: Manifest uploaded. Checksum (sha256): bf3e9d2e8f4a...
alina: Running verify locally: `cosign verify-blob --key $PUBKEY escort-manifest.json` then `jq .chunks escort-manifest.json` to make sure chunk indexes are contiguous.
deploy-bot: Dry-run results: manifest-verify OK, chunked-upload-sim OK, canary-sim: simulated error-rate 0.2%. No automatic rollbacks triggered in sim.
ops-oncall: Two operational asks: 1) set canary AZ-affinity to reduce cross-AZ cold starts; 2) ensure agent resume logic is enabled for interrupted downloads.
alina: Both enabled. deploy-bot set `--az-affinity=canary1` and `--resume-enabled=true`.
ryan: If we need to emergency unpin, what's the command sequence? We should document it here.
alina: Emergency unpin flow (short):
1) `deploy-bot abort --id <thread>` -> stops progression
2) `packaging-bot revoke-signer --id temp-341990` -> revoke token
3) `packaging-bot repoint-release --tag release-stable:v1.5.9` -> update pointer
4) ops-oncall runs carrier revert and confirms mirrors reverted
(some manual signoffs in between).
ops-oncall: I'll standby. If someone posts `@ops-oncall emergency-unpin` in this thread I'll execute step 4.
security: Also add alert rule: if cosign verification fails on >2 hosts within 5m -> auto-abort.
packaging-bot: Added alert rule. Note: revoking signer will invalidate staged tickets; vendor must re-request a signed manifest if we unpin.
vendor-ops: That is fine; we have process to request a new signed manifest after handoff. We just need notification.
alina: Final gating question: anyone object to moving this from dry-run to scheduled rollout at 02:00 UTC?
ryan: No objections from packaging.
security: No objections.
ops-oncall: Clear from oncall side.
deploy-bot: Scheduling rollout window 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-23T04:00:00Z. Canary groups: [3,12,full]. Image: private-installer:v1.6.1@sha256:aa11...cc33.
alina: I'll post the handoff to vendor at 01:45 UTC and include this thread link. Keep this thread as the audit.
ryan: One last note: set `max-concurrent-upload=2` to handle vendor throttle.
deploy-bot: Flag set. Ready to proceed unless someone posts `hold` before 01:50 UTC.
alina: Thanks team. I'll update release notes with chunk/resume instructions for integrators.
vendor-ops: Received. We'll confirm mirror receipts and report any missing chunks to this thread.
packaging-bot: Preflight done. All hashes match. Dry-run success.
deploy-bot: End of thread (dry-run complete).
